slides.body: Meat and cabbage on a hot iron plate, with rice, pickles and miso soup. Order the meat by size: one serving, 1.5, double or triple; rice comes in small to extra large. Yu: rich flavor, the rice goes fast.
slides.cap: Meat and cabbage on a hot iron plate

slides.jp:
鉄板焼肉 大当り
うるま店
slides.body: A Fukuoka (Hakata) specialty, served in Midorimachi, Uruma. Lunch 11:00–15:00 (LO 14:30), dinner 18:00–21:00 (LO 20:30). Open daily except New Year. 20 seats, parking. Cards, IC and QR pay OK. (Tabelog, Nov 17)
